status_semantics: Manual public state only. Staleness or silence is not evidence of danger.
message: This is my stable public contact/continuity address. Keep the URL; channels behind it may change.
contact: Use the signal composer, then send the resulting envelope through any direct channel we already share.
if_unreachable: Try the normal direct channel again.
Try one other channel you already know belongs to me.
If the silence is genuinely unusual and concerning, contact someone who knows me in person.
if_incapacitated: Immediate physical danger: use the appropriate emergency service rather than waiting on this page.
Preserve phone, wallet, keys and electronic devices; do not reset or erase them.
Make sure animals and home have basic care and are physically secure.
Prefer reversible actions. Do not delete, publish, dispose of or transfer digital/project material merely because I am unavailable.
Private handoff information belongs outside this public repository.
privacy: No secrets, private identifiers, medical records, credentials or private correspondence belong in this file.
